verdict.rationale: Dover is a recruiting SaaS with AI features (applicant scoring, AI notetaker, MCP server), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented control, policy, or setting that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Bring-your-own API key and data export are different features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
